package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// LessonRelationRepoPG stores semantic lesson relations in Postgres.
type LessonRelationRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r LessonRelationRepoPG) ReplaceBySourceLesson(ctx context.Context, sourceLessonID string, relations []domain.LessonRelation) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(relations))
	for _, relation := range relations {
		keys = append(keys, relation.SourceKey)
	}

	if len(keys) == 0 {
		_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_relation WHERE source_lesson_id=$1`, sourceLessonID)
		return err
	}
	if _, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_relation WHERE source_lesson_id=$1 AND NOT (source_key = ANY($2::text[]))`, sourceLessonID, keys); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, relation := range relations {
		command, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO lesson_relation (
    id, source_key, source_lesson_id, target_lesson_id, relation, primary_stack, stacks, concepts
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)
ON CONFLICT (source_key) DO UPDATE SET
    primary_stack=EXCLUDED.primary_stack,
    stacks=EXCLUDED.stacks,
    concepts=EXCLUDED.concepts,
    updated_at=now()
WHERE lesson_relation.source_lesson_id=EXCLUDED.source_lesson_id
  AND lesson_relation.target_lesson_id=EXCLUDED.target_lesson_id
  AND lesson_relation.relation=EXCLUDED.relation`,
			relation.ID,
			relation.SourceKey,
			sourceLessonID,
			relation.TargetLessonID,
			relation.Relation,
			relation.PrimaryStack,
			relation.Stacks,
			relation.Concepts,
		)
		if err != nil {
			return mapPgError(err)
		}
		if command.RowsAffected() == 0 {
			return domain.ErrConflict
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func (r LessonRelationRepoPG) ListBySourceLesson(ctx context.Context, sourceLessonID string) ([]domain.LessonRelation, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT
    lr.id,
    lr.source_key,
    lr.source_lesson_id,
    COALESCE(source_lesson.source_key, ''),
    lr.target_lesson_id,
    COALESCE(target_lesson.source_key, ''),
    lr.relation,
    lr.primary_stack,
    lr.stacks,
    lr.concepts,
    lr.created_at,
    lr.updated_at
FROM lesson_relation lr
JOIN lesson source_lesson ON source_lesson.id = lr.source_lesson_id
JOIN lesson target_lesson ON target_lesson.id = lr.target_lesson_id
WHERE lr.source_lesson_id=$1
ORDER BY lr.relation, lr.source_key`, sourceLessonID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := make([]domain.LessonRelation, 0)
	for rows.Next() {
		var relation domain.LessonRelation
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&relation.ID,
			&relation.SourceKey,
			&relation.SourceLessonID,
			&relation.SourceLessonSourceKey,
			&relation.TargetLessonID,
			&relation.TargetLessonSourceKey,
			&relation.Relation,
			&relation.PrimaryStack,
			&relation.Stacks,
			&relation.Concepts,
			&relation.CreatedAt,
			&relation.UpdatedAt,
		); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, relation)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r LessonRelationRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, relationID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	command, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM lesson_relation WHERE id=$1`, relationID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

var _ repository.LessonRelationRepository = (*LessonRelationRepoPG)(nil)
